chapter_meta_description: Han Li’s Gold Devourer Beetles are shredded by a scattershot of golden needles. Facing the Six Dao Sect heir, he must draw his ultimate trump card as a legendary demonic art begins to stir.
og_title: The Beetles Fall – Han Li Faces the Six Extreme True Demon Art!
og_description: A swift and brutal counter. Han Li's legendary insect swarm is no match for Wen Tianren's flying-needle array. The battle escalates as a forbidden technique awakens.
twitter_title: His ultimate swarm just got shredded. Now Han Li faces the Six Dao Sect's true heir.
twitter_description: Nearly 10,000 Gold Devourer Beetles lost in an instant. Han Li must now counter a legendary demonic art.

lore_anchors.definition: Spirit insects famed for their ability to devour most materials, making them nearly indestructible on the battlefield.
A rare and extremely difficult class of magic treasure that relies on immense mental control; more precise and penetrating than standard flying swords.
A one-time-use artifact that seals a portion of a true magic treasure's power, often used by cultivators who cannot yet wield the real item.
A legendary, top-tier demonic cultivation technique of the Chaotic Star Sea, known for its overwhelming power and drastic environmental effects upon activation.
The ambient, formless energy that permeates the world; high-level spells and formations can absorb it locally, causing massive disruptions to the surrounding environment.
